title: Stockholm concert: Ben Webster, Teddy Wilson and Charlie Shavers sit in
summary: At a Stockholm concert Ben Webster, Don Byas, Teddy Wilson and Charlie Shavers showed up and joined the stand.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: And -- who was -- I'm trying to think of all the guys who was there, came to see us. We had quite a thing there. Ah! I got a picture that I have to show you. I must have it in this thing here. We were doing that concert in -- uh, --
No. No, was on the tenor, the other tenor. He used to be with Duke Ellington. He died --

Uh, the alto man who left with -- no, tenor. He went over was -- years ago with Webster, and there was a toss-up between him, Wilson, and -- he passed too, not too long ago. He stayed over there for years.

Don Bias. (Laughs.) Don Bias. (unintelligible) And we were on stage playing, Teddy Wilson was on piano. He came in. He happened to be there, but he wasn't with us, but he happened to be there, and he came on the stand and started playing. And Charlie Shavers. Lord, I looked up, and I saw Charlie --
